components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The cinnabar-filled command for the primary action in the workbench or quick dock.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 15px; border: 1px solid var(--cinnabar); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--cinnabar); color: #fff; font: 700 14px/1.3 var(--font-ui); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms ease, background-color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { border-color: var(--cinnabar-dark); background: var(--cinnabar-dark); } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: An outlined jade command for secondary actions such as disconnect or navigation.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 15px; border: 1px solid var(--jade); border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: var(--jade-dark); font: 700 14px/1.3 var(--font-ui); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms ease, background-color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: #e7dfbd; } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A paper-filled standard field for room identity, prayer text, and simulation input.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label">Username hoặc liên kết Live<input class="ds-input-text" type="text" placeholder="@username hoặc liên kết TikTok Live"></label>
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink-soft); font: 600 13px/1.5 var(--font-ui); } .ds-input-text { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #a9a184; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--paper-light); color: var(--ink); font: 400 14px/1.45 var(--font-ui); } .ds-input-text::placeholder { color: #625e4e; opacity: 1; } .ds-input-text:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ritual Action Tile
components.description: A two-line workbench action with a clear command name and small ritual detail.
components.css: .ds-ritual-tile { display: flex; min-width: 0; min-height: 62px; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center; gap: 3px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #aaa183; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--paper-light); color: var(--ink); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 140ms ease, background-color 140ms ease; } .ds-ritual-tile:hover { border-color: var(--jade); background: #e8e0bd; } .ds-ritual-tile:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-ritual-name { font: 700 14px/1.3 var(--font-ui); } .ds-ritual-detail { color: var(--ink-soft); font: 400 12px/1.5 var(--font-ui); }

components.name: Live Status Plaque
components.description: A light-paper connection plaque with a distinct green connected indicator.
components.html: LIVE @username · 120 người xem
components.css: .ds-live-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(31, 43, 38, 0.7); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--paper-light); color: var(--ink); font: 600 22px/1.2 var(--font-ui); } .ds-live-dot { width: 12px; height: 12px; flex: 0 0 12px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--cinnabar); } .ds-live-dot-connected { background: var(--success); }

components.name: Workbench Sheet
components.description: An outer paper work area that groups related tasks with a single broad shadow.
components.html:
Kết nối TikTok Live

Dùng username hoặc liên kết phòng đang phát.
components.css: .ds-workbench-sheet { padding: 22px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft); } .ds-workbench-sheet h2 { margin: 0; color: var(--ink); font: 700 21px/1.25 var(--font-ui); } .ds-workbench-sheet p { margin: 5px 0 0; color: var(--ink-soft); font: 400 13px/1.5 var(--font-ui); }

components.name: Viewer Gift Tile
components.description: A large viewer-facing contribution card in the live stage footer.
components.css: .ds-viewer-gift { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--jade); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-viewer-gift:hover { background: #fff5d2; } .ds-viewer-gift:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-gift-cost { color: var(--jade-dark); font: 800 17px/1.3 var(--font-ui); } .ds-gift-title { color: var(--ink); font: 800 25px/1.3 var(--font-ui); }

components.name: Header Navigation Link
components.description: An outlined link in the deep-jade admin header for opening the live and OBS views.
components.css: .ds-header-link { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 248, 223, 0.48); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--paper-light); font: 400 13px/1.5 var(--font-ui); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-header-link:hover { color: var(--jade-dark); background: var(--paper-light); } .ds-header-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The Living Prayer Petition treats the live interface as a working sớ: paper that records each prayer as it happens. Warm stock, charcoal ink, and fine rules keep information orderly; the supplied temple scene provides the ornament and remains the visual anchor. Cinnabar marks primary action and active prayer, jade anchors connection and enabled controls, a related success green marks affirmative state, and brass stays a fine detail.

The viewer scene and operator workbench carry equal weight. The live page keeps its portrait temple artwork in front, with compact state and count plaques above the active devotee, viewer actions, and merit list. The admin page turns connection, voice testing, ritual commands, simulation, and JSON-RPC feedback into an event-focused workbench. Be Vietnam Pro carries operational text and admin section headings; Noto Serif gives page titles and ritual names a quieter ceremonial voice.
keyCharacteristics: A working paper petition layered over the existing temple scene.
Clear role separation across ink, paper, jade, cinnabar, and brass.
A live portrait composition paired with a practical operator workbench.

rules.name: The Seal Rule
rules.body: Reserve cinnabar for primary commands and active prayer marks; use jade for connection and enabled states, and keep brass to fine detail.

rules.name: The Two Voice Rule
rules.body: Keep operational headings and control text in Be Vietnam Pro; use Noto Serif for page titles and ritual names, not for admin section headings.

rules.name: The Portrait Stage Rule
rules.body: Keep the live scene at 9:16, center it on desktop, move controls below it on phones, and hide them in OBS mode.

rules.name: The Single Sheet Rule
rules.body: Keep the work surface flat inside the shadowed outer sheet; thin separators group tasks without stacking nested cards.

dos: Do keep the supplied temple artwork as the scene's main ornament and use paper plaques for readable live information.
Do set operational copy and admin section headings in Be Vietnam Pro; reserve Noto Serif for page titles and ritual names.
Do keep primary actions and active prayer marks in cinnabar, and connected or enabled states in jade.
Do keep controls and fields at the established 44px minimum height where that rule is implemented.
donts: Don't use emoji as control iconography.
Don't stack decorative cards inside the workbench sheets.
Don't add decorative gradients to the admin workbench; the supplied temple artwork carries the visual ornament.
